m_water: Your emotions. Clear water: calm and clarity; muddy water: confusion that needs sorting out.
m_sea: The depth of your feelings and the unknown. A calm sea brings peace; a rough one, strong emotions to face.
m_river: The flow of your life. Going with the current means acceptance; crossing it, a change you are ready for.
m_rain: Release and renewal: something old is washed away and growth follows.
m_fire: Passion, anger or transformation. Something in your life is changing fast.
m_snake: Hidden fears or a person you do not fully trust — or healing and change, as the snake sheds its skin.
m_dog: Loyalty and friendship. A friendly dog: support near you; an angry one: a conflict with a friend.
m_cat: Independence, intuition and mystery. Trust your instincts about a situation.
m_horse: Strength, freedom and drive. Riding well means you are in control of your path.
m_bird: Freedom, hopes and news on the way. Flying birds: wishes taking off.
m_fish: Ideas and opportunities from the deep; in folk tradition, good luck and blessing.
m_spider: Patience and creativity — or feeling caught in a situation you need to untangle.
m_lion: Courage, pride and power. You may need to stand up for yourself.
m_wolf: Instinct and loyalty — or a threat you sense. Listen to your gut.
m_baby: A new beginning, a fresh idea or a project that needs your care.
m_wedding: Union and commitment — joining two parts of your life, or a promise to yourself.
m_death: Rarely about real death: an ending that makes room for something new.
m_funeral: Letting go of the past — saying goodbye to a habit, a role or a chapter.
m_flying: Freedom and rising above a problem. You feel capable and light.
m_falling: Losing control or fear of failure. Find what you can hold on to.
m_chased: Avoiding a problem or a feeling. What you run from often wants to be faced.
m_teeth: Worries about how you look, speak or age; in folk belief, news about family.
m_hair: Strength and self-image. Cutting hair: a change you choose.
m_blood: Life energy and strong emotion; sometimes tiredness that needs rest.
m_money: Self-worth and energy you give or receive. Finding money: an opportunity; losing it: worry about value.
m_gold: Something precious in you or your life; success that you earned.
m_house: Yourself and your inner life. New rooms: new sides of you to discover.
m_door: Opportunities and transitions. An open door invites you in; a locked one asks for patience.
m_key: A solution or an answer within reach.
m_car: How you steer your life. Driving yourself: control; a passenger: letting others decide.
m_train: A path with a set direction. Missing the train: fear of losing a chance.
m_airplane: Big plans and goals taking off; travel or a change of perspective.
m_road: Your life direction. A clear road: confidence; a crossroads: a choice ahead.
m_bridge: A transition — moving from one stage of life to the next.
m_mountain: A goal or a challenge. Reaching the top: achievement within reach.
m_tree: Growth, family and roots. A green tree: health and stability.
m_flower: Beauty, love and things blooming in your life.
m_garden: Your inner world and what you cultivate; a well-kept garden means care paying off.
m_moon: Intuition, cycles and the hidden side of things.
m_sun: Clarity, success and warmth. Things are coming to light.
m_star: Hopes, guidance and dreams worth following.
m_light: Understanding and hope; an answer is near.
m_dark: The unknown or fears you have not looked at yet.
m_exam: Feeling judged or unprepared. Often a sign you care about doing well.
m_naked: Feeling exposed or vulnerable — or the wish to be seen as you really are.
m_mirror: Self-reflection: how you see yourself and how you think others see you.
m_phone: Communication: a message you need to send or hear.
m_letter: News or something unsaid that wants to be expressed.
m_food: Nourishment — what feeds your body, mind or heart.
m_bread: Basic needs, work and blessing; sharing bread: generosity.
m_fruit: The rewards of your efforts; ripe fruit: results are ready.
m_egg: Potential and new life; something is about to hatch.
m_shoes: Your path and how ready you are for it. Losing shoes: feeling unprepared.
m_clothes: The role you show to others; new clothes: a new image.
m_king: Authority and self-worth; you may be ready to lead.
m_police: Rules, guilt or the need for protection.
m_thief: Feeling that something — time, energy, credit — is being taken from you.
m_war: Inner conflict or tension with someone; a call to find peace.
m_knife: Cutting ties or a sharp decision; also words that hurt.
m_ghost: Unfinished business or memories that still visit you.
m_mother: Care, comfort and your own nurturing side.
m_ex: Usually not about the person: a lesson or feeling from that time is resurfacing.
m_friend: A quality you admire in that friend, or a need for connection.
m_stranger: An unknown side of yourself, or something new entering your life.
m_doctor: Healing and the need to take care of yourself.
m_sick: Something feels out of balance; rest and care are needed.
m_pregnant: Something new growing inside you — an idea, a plan or a change.
m_crying: Release; in folk belief, often joy that follows sadness.
m_laughing: Joy and relief; tension is easing.
m_earthquake: Big change shaking your foundations; time to rebuild stronger.
m_storm: Emotional turmoil that will pass, clearing the air.
m_snow: Calm, purity or feelings on pause.
m_flood: Feeling overwhelmed by emotions or tasks.
m_forest: The unconscious and the unknown; finding your own way.
m_desert: Loneliness or a dry spell before renewal.
m_island: The wish to rest or to be alone for a while.
m_ship: Your journey through emotions; a steady boat means you are coping well.
m_swimming: How you handle your feelings; swimming easily means you are in tune with them.
m_stairs: Progress — going up means growth; going down, looking into yourself.
m_prison: Feeling limited by a situation, a role or your own thoughts.
m_lost: Uncertainty about your direction; a sign to pause and choose.
m_late: Fear of missed chances or too much pressure.
m_book: Knowledge and wisdom you are looking for.
m_gift: Recognition, talent or a pleasant surprise coming.
m_mouse: Small worries that nibble at your peace.
m_bee: Hard work and community; honey: sweet rewards.
m_butterfly: Transformation and lightness; you are changing for the better.
lucid:
Lucid dreaming means knowing that you are dreaming while you dream. Signs you are close: vivid dreams, remembering several dreams a night, sometimes thinking «this is strange».
Reality checks: several times a day, ask «am I dreaming?» and test it — look at your hands, read a text twice, or try to breathe with your nose pinched. In a dream these often fail.
Dream journal: write every dream as soon as you wake. Within weeks you will notice your own «dream signs».
Before sleep (MILD): repeat «next time I dream, I will know I am dreaming» and imagine noticing it.
Wake back to bed: wake up after about five hours of sleep, stay up for 15–20 minutes, then go back to sleep with that intention.
When you become lucid, stay calm: rub your hands or look at the ground to stay in the dream.
Never give up sleep for it: good, regular sleep matters more than any technique.
lucid_ex:
Do five reality checks today and look at your hands each time.
Write down every dream you remember this morning, even one image.
Choose a «dream sign» from your journal and look for it today.
Tonight, before sleep, repeat ten times: «I will know when I am dreaming».
Every time you go through a door today, ask: «am I dreaming?»
Read a line of text, look away, and read it again — would it change in a dream?
Go to bed at the same time tonight and wake slowly tomorrow.
Draw one scene from a recent dream.
Set one intention for your next dream: a place you would like to visit.
Avoid screens for the last half hour before sleep tonight.
When you wake tonight, stay still for a minute and replay your dream.
Ask yourself three times today: «how did I get here?»
Tell someone one of your dreams; saying it helps memory.
Keep a pen and paper by the bed tonight.
